subj: Re: Supported SONiC for Saga Ethernet Switches | COMPUTEX
text:
Hi, Oksana,
Thanks for your information.

1. Good to know that everything is going well there!

2. In previous emails, we discussed high-speed network switches(Marvell
based and CENTEC based) and L2 / L3 Ethernet switches for SMBs.
Your focus is on Marvell SONiC for high-speed networks.
But we are currently using CENTEC chips for this category.
As I explained, this is easier for us considering technical & commercial
resources and ROI.
We are just using Marvell chips for L2 / L3 switches, mostly 1G / 10G based.
Based on our current product direction, we do not see an immediate fit for
Marvell SONiC integration.
Sorry...
Anyway, thanks for this.

3. Today should be the last day for this exhibition.
Wish you a fruitful one and a happy DIY travel after the show.

Thank you.
